CustomField.label: Correlation Id
CustomField.description: Correlation id of the request that produced this row: the caller's X-Correlation-Id header, the Correlation ID input of a Flow action, or one generated for the request or console action. Returned in every REST response, so a request can be traced to its audit rows. Blank on Alert rows and on rows written outside a request, such as by a scheduled job. Marked as an external id so it is indexed.
